header.title: Anomalies
header.description: Nine statistical and integrity rules running live across every disclosure in scope. Findings are severity-ranked, traceable to the disclosure, and fully dismissable with an audit-logged reason.

distribution.title: Where the flags are
distribution.subtitle: Which rule types fire most, and which entities carry the load.

method.title: The nine rules
method.subtitle: Every check here is one an external auditor would run by hand. No black boxes, no AI hype — just statistically sound industry-standard checks.
method.short: Nine auditor-grade checks — no black boxes.

triage.title: Investigation queue
triage.subtitle: Per-anomaly workflow: investigate, resolve, or dismiss. Status changes are logged to the audit trail.
triage.clearedBody: Every figure in scope tracks within its historical range and has its evidence.
triage.showingFirst: Showing the first {{shown}} of {{total}}. Narrow the filters to see the rest.

feed.title: Live anomaly feed
feed.subtitle: Sorted by severity. Open any flag to land on the disclosure. Suppress with a reason to mark acknowledged.

dismissModal.title: Dismiss anomaly
dismissModal.body: Reviewers must record why this anomaly can be ignored. The reason is logged to the audit trail and attached to the persisted status row.
dismissModal.placeholder: e.g. Spike caused by acquisition of new subsidiary in Q3; confirmed legitimate

errors.aiNotConfigured: AI is not configured. Ask an admin to set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

ai.title: Explain with AI
ai.subtitle: Persisted anomalies with optional AI narratives: plain-language explanations grounded in the underlying activity data.
ai.disabledBodyAfter: in the server environment to generate plain-English explanations. Previously-generated narratives below remain viewable.
ai.empty: No persisted anomalies in this workspace.
ai.generatedBy: Generated by Claude. Verify before sharing.
ai.orgOffTitle: AI is switched off for your organisation
ai.orgOffBody: Existing narratives stay readable. An admin can turn AI back on in Settings → Market & compliance.
ai.deploymentOffBody: This deployment has no AI provider configured. Existing narratives stay readable; ask your administrator to connect one.
ai.generatedNote: Generated by AI from the underlying activity data. Verify before relying on it.
ai.label: AI-generated
ai.labelTitle: This content is produced by an AI model and must be reviewed

yoy_spike.title: Year-over-year variance
yoy_spike.desc: Current value vs the most recent historical filing. Warns above ±20%, critical above ±50%.

magnitude_jump.title: Magnitude jump
magnitude_jump.desc: 8×+ (or ≤0.125×) the 4-year historical average — catches unit typos (tonnes vs kg, m³ vs litres).

z_score_outlier.title: Statistical outlier
z_score_outlier.desc: Z-score against 4-year baseline. Warn at |z|>2, critical at |z|>3.

trend_break.title: Trend break
trend_break.desc: Reverses a 3-year monotonic direction by more than 10%. Worth a narrative explanation.

unit_change.title: Unit mismatch
unit_change.desc: Current unit string differs from the unit used in historical filings. Confirm conversion.

missing_evidence.title: Missing evidence
missing_evidence.desc: Submitted, reviewed, or approved numeric entry with no evidence file attached. Audit fails without this.

late_submission.title: Late submission
late_submission.desc: Submitted after the recorded due date. Tracked for process improvement.

narrative_gap.title: Narrative gap
narrative_gap.desc: Narrative disclosure approved with empty narrative_body. Disclosure will not appear in the published report.

peer_deviation.title: Peer plant deviation
peer_deviation.desc: Plant value sits >2σ from sibling plants for the same disclosure — boundary or operating difference.

feedWidget.title: Anomalies flagged
feedWidget.allClear: All values track within historical range and evidence is complete.
feedWidget.suppressTitle: Suppress — mark as acknowledged with reason
feedWidget.reasonTooShort: Explain in at least 10 characters — this is the audit trail.
feedWidget.suppressBody: Nothing is deleted — the anomaly stays on record and is visible via "show suppressed". Your reason is logged in the audit chain.
feedWidget.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. 'Boundary expanded in FY2026 to include Plant D, values not directly comparable'

toast.dismissed: Dismissed — reason logged to the audit trail
